% Adapted from the TeX Live 2025 pgfgantt manual's hgrid/vgrid style-list example.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfgantt}

\begin{document}
\begin{ganttchart}[
  x unit=0.45cm,
  y unit title=0.55cm,
  y unit chart=0.7cm,
  hgrid=true,
  vgrid={*2{red}, *1{green}, *{10}{blue, dashed}}
]{1}{20}
  \gantttitle{Title 1}{20} \\
  \ganttbar{Phase A}{1}{8} \\
  \ganttbar{Phase B}{9}{20}
\end{ganttchart}
\end{document}
